generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a single entity and shall be a manufacturer of boiler pressure parts. The Bidder should have successfully executed erection/retrofitting works involving new Platen Super Heater, Reheater, Final Super Heater coil assemblies, or any other boiler pressure part assemblies of 210 MW or higher capacity for M/s BHEL, M/s NTPC, or State GENCOs during the preceding ten (10) years. The boiler in which such works were executed shall have been in successful operation for a minimum period of one year as on the date falling one month prior to the bid submission date. In support of this, the bidder shall furnish copies of multiple Purchase Orders/ Work Orders not more than five of similar works of value amounting to 24 Crore for having supplied.(OR) The Bidder may be a Consortium. In such a case, one Consortium Partner shall be a manufacturer of boiler pressure parts and shall have been a regular supplier of boiler pressure part assemblies for 210 MW or higher capacity boilers to M/s BHEL, M/s NTPC, or State GENCOs during the preceding ten years. The other Consortium Partner shall be a Special Class Boiler Repairer/Erector holding a valid IBR Certificate and shall have successfully executed erection/retrofitting works involving complete sets of Platen Super Heater, Reheater, Final Super Heater coil assemblies, or any other boiler pressure part assemblies for 210 MW or higher capacity boilers for M/s BHEL, M/s NTPC, or State GENCOs during the preceding ten (10) years. The boiler in which such works were executed shall have been in successful operation for a minimum period of one year as on the date falling one month prior to the bid submission date. In support of this, the bidder (Consortium partners) shall furnish copies of multiple Purchase Orders/ Work Orders not more than five of similar works of value amounting to 24 Crore for having supplied.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of Purchase Orders, Work Orders, Work Completion Certificates relevant to Technical criteria.

technicalCriterionList.description: The annual turnover of the Bidder, in at least two (2) of the preceding five (5) financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26), as on the original scheduled date of Techno-Commercial bid opening, shall not be less than Rs.94 Crore (Rupees Ninety-Four Crore only). In the case of a Consortium, the combined annual turnover of both Consortium Partners shall be considered for evaluation. The Net Worth of the Bidder, as on the last day of the preceding financial year, i.e., 31.03.2026, shall be positive
